title: Meta Ads & Advantage+ Health Audit Report

sections.executiveSummary: Executive overview of Meta Graph API ad accounts, Advantage+ Shopping efficiency, and creative fatigue.
sections.overallScore: Deterministic performance score (0-100) combining blended ROAS, frequency saturation, and CAPI health.
sections.findings: Audited account structure, CBO/ABO allocation, Advantage+ creative performance, and audience fragmentation.
sections.issues: Identified auction overlap, creative fatigue (frequency > 3.5), and degraded Event Match Quality.
sections.recommendations: Actionable proposals for budget consolidation, creative rotation, and CAPI deduplication fixes.
sections.priorityMatrix: Urgency classification matrix from immediate waste reduction to creative expansion.
sections.actionPlan: Detailed execution steps for campaign scaling and underperforming ad set pauses.
sections.supportingEvidence: Meta Insights metric tables, frequency distributions, and Event Quality Match metrics.
sections.appendix: Meta attribution settings (7-day click / 1-day view), Pixel ID list, and catalog connection status.
